sents.t: On Tuesday, I took a day off work and went to the DMV, the Department of Motor Vehicles.
I waited for forty-five minutes before a woman called my number.
“Please fill out this form,” she said.
“You have to show your passport and two documents with your address. Do you have them?”
Luckily, I had my passport, a bank statement, and my lease.
Then she said, “Read the letters on the wall, please.” That was the eye test.
Next, I took the written test on a computer.
I studied for two weeks, so I passed!
The road test was a week later.
A serious examiner sat next to me.
I didn’t have to drive on the highway, but I had to parallel park.
My hands were sweating, but I did it.
“Congratulations. You passed,” the examiner said, and finally she smiled.
Then a man took my photo.
My new driver’s license came in the mail ten days later!
